_about: 1-24, authored for wave 4a (round 1) on the build with the portal tap, stone and wake rules. The player never moves: he stands
on the ramp where he lands (256, 143); the launcher at (74, -42) throws a stone down the open left side every 90 ticks (the first on tick 90), and
the breakable wall at (448, 177) is the floor over the door room. The level's own pair, which is its golden score of 2: a portal
over the wall at (448, 110) (tap 40, placed 95) and one in the stones' fall line at (74, 90) (tap 110, placed 163). The second
stone (thrown on 180) goes in on 206 and breaks the wall on 245 at stone hit 6.67 (the original's gate is a stone above 1.5); the first,
thrown while only the far portal stood, fell past.
THE DOOR CANNOT BE WALKED TO IN THIS PORT: dropped through the hole he lands on the door's platform at x 405 and walking right
he is killed on tick 366 at x 432 (PLAYER DIED: destroyier_ent_1051), because destroyier.ent's 16 px killing box at (448, 344)
(x 440 to 456, y 336 to 352) stands on the platform's top across the door's trigger (x 443 to 451, y 319 to 343) and his body
meets the box 3 to 5 units before the trigger from either side (STK-8: the listing has no callback that makes a destroyier
kill a player; the owner's testimony of 11 September says it does). So the route goes over it with a second pair: a portal
high over the door at (445, 100) (tap 262, placed 316) and one on the player (tap 322, 6 after the landing): he comes out at
(445, 102), falls 211 units and meets the door's trigger on tick 343 with his feet 5 units above the box. From the start the
ray reaches a target only down to y 118 (a tap at y 130 is stopped by the ramp's top-right corner at (384, 129)); every x
436 to 456 and every y 60 to 118 won, and the tap waits until 262, 17 ticks after the wall, because the falling stone is the
ray's end (the tap on 239 ended at (431.3, 103.1) on its surface, outside the door's x). Won on tick 343. Four portals and no
crystal (the ramp's timed one at (366, 118) goes by): medal 1; no achievement.
